title: pvForceTime
body:
## pvForceTime

Makes its output use one fixed time, ForcedTime (ParaView default 0.0), whatever time the scene requests: the upstream pipeline is updated once at ForcedTime, the result is cached, and every time step it reports is replaced by ForcedTime. Use it to hold a reference state, such as the initial geometry or a chosen snapshot, fixed while the rest of the scene follows the selected times. With IgnorePipelineTime false it passes the input through unchanged.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- ForcedTime is a time value in the input's units, not an index; use a stored time, because how a time between stored steps is served is decided by the upstream reader.
- ParaView's static ForcedTime is 0.0; set it explicitly when the case does not start at 0.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ForceTime`. Identity: `filters/ForceTime`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the ForceTime filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ForcedTime` | This property specifies the time to request. If the IgnorePipelineTime property is set, then this value will override any time request in the VTK pipeline. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `IgnorePipelineTime` | If set to 0, this filter will do nothing, only shallow copy the input to the output. If set to 1, this filter will always request the ForcedTime to the pipeline, ignoring time requests. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

```json
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvForceTime",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
